name: Glyph
description:
Casting time: Variable.

You inscribe a hidden glyph on a surface or within a closable object, covering up to a 10 ft diameter area. Inscribing takes 1 minute per foot of diameter (minimum 1 minute). The glyph becomes invisible once inscribed.

Choose a spell you know with an XP cost no greater than this spell’s XP cost and pay its MP cost. The spell is stored in the glyph. Then define a trigger based on observable conditions at the glyph’s location, such as proximity, contact, opening the object, or a spoken phrase, including any creatures types or specific creatures that do or don’t trigger it.

Roll Lore to set the Difficulty. A creature that attempts to detect the glyph rolls Lore against the Difficulty. On a pass, the glyph becomes visible to it, and it learns the Mestiere and School of the stored spell.

When triggered, the stored spell is cast, targeting the nearest creature(s) or the glyph’s location, as appropriate. The glyph then vanishes.
successes:
✨: You may define a second trigger.

✨: The Difficulty increases by 2.

🌞: You may choose to make the glyph persist until it has been triggered 3 times, at which point it vanishes. At least 1 minute after one triggering before it can be triggered again.

💀: The spell is immediately triggered.
